events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1925 , after studying for two terms at Munich University , Fegelein joined the Reiter-Regiment 17

events.text: Fegelein joined the Bavarian State Police in Munich as an officer cadet.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 20 April 1927 , he joined the Bavarian State Police in Munich as an officer cadet

events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1929 he left the police service

events.text: Fegelein joined the Nazi Party and the SA.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Fegelein joined the Nazi Party ( membership number 1,200,158 ) and the SA in 1930

events.subject: self
events.quote: He transferred to the SA on 10 April 1933

events.text: Fegelein took over administration of the school from his father.
events.subject: self
events.quote: By the mid-1930s he took over administration of the school from his father

events.text: Fegelein was promoted to the Allgemeine-SS rank of SS-Untersturmführer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was promoted to the Allgemeine-SS rank of SS-Untersturmführer that year

events.text: Fegelein oversaw the preparation of the courses and facilities for the equestrian events of the Berlin Olympic Games.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Beginning in November 1935 , Fegelein oversaw the preparation of the courses and facilities for the equestrian events of the Berlin Olympic Games

events.text: Fegelein was promoted to the rank of SS-Sturmbannführer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was promoted to the rank of SS-Sturmbannführer on 30 January 1936

events.subject: self
events.quote: Fegelein won the international tournament in 1937

events.text: Fegelein was promoted to the rank of SS-Obersturmbannführer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was promoted to the rank of SS-Obersturmbannführer on 30 January

events.text: Fegelein was named commander of the Haupt-Reitschule München and promoted to SS-Standartenführer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 25 July 1937 , Reichsführer-SS Himmler , by special order of the SS-Oberabschnitt Süd , created the Haupt-Reitschule München

events.text: Fegelein won the Brown Ribbon of Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Fegelein won the ( Brown Ribbon of Germany ) , an annual horse race which in 1938 was held on the premises of the riding school in Munich
